old.question: One argument given in support of personal writing is that it
options: has informal features which make it more diverting than impersonal writing
makes writers more focused and less boring
can be more objective than impersonal writing

old.question: Select the option that best explains the information conveyed in the sentence: Visitors who are observant do not outstay their welcome.
options: All visitors must be alert so as to know when to leave a place
Some visitors know when to leave a place so as to make their hosts happy
Some visitors are unable to know when their hosts do not want them around
All visitors, except a few, know when to leave a place

old.answerNote: 'Visitors who are observant' refers to some visitors, the observant ones, who know when to leave (B). The key's A (all visitors must be alert) captures the same lesson as advice, so both are marked right.

old.question: Choose the option OPPOSITE in meaning to the word(s) in capitals: As an ABSOLUTE RULER, Adayi brooks no opposition from his subordinates.

old.question: From the passage, which of the following is the most important reason why Nigerian pidgin is popular?

it is extensively used along the coast

old.question: From the passage, doctors find it hard to convince their patients of the gravity of lack of sleep because
options: it is caused by a variety of reasons
the patients are often tired and cannot get enough sleep
people believe that it enhances one's personality
its impact on the patient is slow

old.answerNote: The variety of causes (A, the key's answer) is mentioned about insomnia, not as the reason patients ignore sleep loss. The last paragraph gives two reasons: some consider chronic fatigue 'a status symbol' (C), and the condition 'often worsens very gradually' (D). Both are marked right.

old.question: The maximum wage legislation seeks to
options: fix wages above the equilibrium wage rate
set wages below the equilibrium wage rate

old.explanation: A maximum wage is a legal ceiling on pay; to have any effect it must be set below the equilibrium wage rate.
old.answerNote: A maximum wage is an upper limit on the wages payable (D), and to be effective that limit is set below the equilibrium wage rate (B). Both describe the same policy, so either is accepted.

old.question: The demand curve for a luxury good is
old.explanation: Here a luxury good is taken as a good of ostentation (prestige), bought partly because it is expensive, so more is demanded at a higher price and the curve slopes upwards: an exceptional demand curve.

old.question:
Use the following information: 
Jide and Haruna contribute ₦12,000 each as capital and share profit equally. Jide draws ₦1,500 and Haruna ₦1,700 half-yearly. The profit for the year is ₦10,000. Jide receives a salary of ₦2,000.

Calculate the profit available for appropriation
old.explanation: Jide's salary of ₦2,000 is taken first, leaving ₦10,000 − ₦2,000 = ₦8,000 to be shared equally between the partners.
old.answerNote: Option C is also correct. A partner's salary is itself an appropriation of profit, so strictly the whole net profit of ₦10,000 is available for appropriation (C); ₦8,000 (D) is what remains to be shared in the profit-sharing ratio after the salary. Both readings are common, so both are accepted.

new.question:
Use the following information: 
Jide and Haruna contribute ₦12,000 each as capital and share profit equally. Jide draws ₦1,500 and Haruna ₦1,700 half-yearly. The profit for the year is ₦10,000. Jide receives a salary of ₦2,000.

Calculate the profit available for appropriation
new.explanation: The whole net profit of ₦10,000 is available for appropriation (C). Jide's ₦2,000 salary is itself an appropriation; deducting it leaves ₦8,000 for sharing, not the initial profit available for appropriation.
new.bookletNote: The supplied key gives D (₦8,000), the residual profit after Jide's salary. The question asks for profit available for appropriation, which is C (₦10,000).
new.answerNote: C alone is accepted. A partner's salary is an appropriation of net profit, not a business expense. The ₦8,000 remaining after the salary is the residual profit available for sharing.
